references.scene: Guild dining hall: ordinary gameplay, table end and stair doorway
visible_findings: Long decorated timber table has a pale central strip bordered in teal, dark curling surface motifs and separate mugs on pale coasters.
Small round red-covered stools sit at the table; large timber casks are visible at left.
Red wall panels stand between heavy timber posts over dark circular-pattern lower panels; a pointed stone opening holds stairs leading toward daylight.
A narrow pointed blue/purple window is visible high on the left wall.
limits: Maze and child Hero obscure the foreground, and table ends/room boundaries are cropped. Full furniture count, floor plan and lighting values are unestablished.
This is dining-hall evidence, not neutral Library or Maze-study evidence.
